verses.en: Now it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, and the princes of the king, even ten men with him, came unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and there they did eat bread together in Mizpah.
verses.sm: Isamaeli Uaooi le fitu o masina, ona o mai ai lea o Isamaeli le atalii o Netanaia, le atalii o Elisama, o le aiga to tino o le tupu, ma alii sa i Ie tupu, ma tagata e toasefulu faatasi ma ia, ia Ketalia le atalii o Aikamo i Mesepa; ua latou aai foi faatasi i lea mea i Mesepa.

verses.en: Then arose Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and the ten men that were with him, and smote Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword, and slew him, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.
verses.sm: Ona tulai ai lea o Isamaeli le atalii o Netanaia, ma ia tagata e toasefulu na ia te ia, ma latou fasi ia Ketalia le atalii o Aikamo le atalii o Safana, i le pelu, na fasiotia e i latou o ia na tofia e le tupu o Papelonia e pule i le nuu.

verses.en: Ishmael also slew all the Jews that were with him, even with Gedaliah, at Mizpah, and the Chaldeans that were found there, and the men of war.
verses.sm: Ua fasia foi e Isamaeli o Iuta uma sa ia Ketalia i Mesepa, ma Kaletaia, o tagata tau, ua latou maua i lea mea.

verses.en: And it came to pass the second day after he had slain Gedaliah, and no man knew it,
verses.sm: Ua oo i le lua o aso talu ona fasiotia e ia o Ketalia, ma ua le iloa e se tasi;

verses.en: That there came certain from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria, even fourscore men, having their beards shaven, and their clothes rent, and having cut themselves, with offerings and incense in their hand, to bring them to the house of the LORD.
verses.sm: ona O mai ai lea o tagata mai Sekema, ma Sailo, ma Samaria, o tagata e toavalugafulu, ua tau a latou “ava, ma ua saei o latou ofu, ua selei foi i latou e i latou, saio latou lima o taulaga i mea e ‘ai ma pulu lipano, e avatua i le fale o le ALII.

verses.en: And Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went forth from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went: and it came to pass, as he met them, he said unto them, Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.
verses.sm: Ona alu atu ai lea ai Mesepa o Isamaeli le atalii e Netanaia, e faafetaiai ia i latou, ua savali ia ma tagi fano; ua 00 ina fetaiai o ia ma i latou, ona fai atu ai lea o ia ia tei latou, Ina o mai ia ia Ketalia le atalii o Aikamo.

verses.en: And it was so, when they came into the midst of the city, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah slew them, and cast them into the midst of the pit, he, and the men that were with him.
verses.sm: Na 00 foi i latou i totonu O le aai, ona fasiotia ai lea o i latou e Isamaeli le atalii o Netanaia ma lafo ia te i latou i totonu O le lua, o ia lava, ma tagata na ia te ia.

verses.en: But ten men were found among them that said unto Ishmael, Slay us not: for we have treasures in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey. So he forbare, and slew them not among their brethren.
verses.sm: Ae peitai sa ia te i latou o tagata e toasefulu, na fai mai ia Isamaeli, Aua e te fasiotia i matou; aua ua la te i matou mea ua natia i le vao, o saito, ma karite, ma suauu, ma meli; ona tuu lea e ia, ua na le fasiotia i latou faatasi ma O latou uso.

verses.en: Now the pit wherein Ishmael had cast all the dead bodies of the men, whom he had slain because of Gedaliah, was it which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel: and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with them that were slain.
verses.sm: O le lua foi na lafo i ai e Isamaeli tino o tagata oti uma na ia fasia ona o Ketalia, o le lua lea na faia e Asa le tupu, ona o Paasa le tupu o Isaraelu; na faatumuina ai c Isamaeli le atalii o Netanaia i e na fasia.

verses.en: Then Ishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people that were in Mizpah, even the king's daughters, and all the people that remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam: and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the Ammonites.
verses.sm: Ona ave ai lea faatagataotaua e Isamaeli o e na totoe uma o le nuu na i Mesepa, o afafine foi o le tupu, ma le nuu uma na totoe i Mesepa, na tuuina atu e Nepusatana le pule i le ‘au e faafeao ia Ketalia le atalii o Aikamo e pule ai; ua ave i latou faatagataotaua e Isamaeli le atalii o Netanaia, ua alu atu foi ia e sopoia atu i le fanauga a Amoni.

verses.en: But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,
verses.sm: A ua faalogo e loanana le atalii o Karea, ma alii uma sa ia te ia na ave ‘au, i le leaga uma na faia e Isamaeli le atalii o Netanaia,

verses.en: Then they took all the men, and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon.
verses.sm: ona latou ave ai lea o tagata uma, ma latou o e tau ma Isamaeli le atalii o Netanaia, na latou maua foi o ia e lata ane i le vai tele i Kipeona.

verses.en: Now it came to pass, that when all the people which were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, then they were glad.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e le nuu uma sa ia Isamaeli, o Ioanana le atalii o Karea, ma alii uma sa ia te ia na ave “au, ona latou fiafia ai lea.

verses.en: So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah cast about and returned, and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah.
verses.sm: Ua liliu mai foi le nuu uma na ave faatagataotaua E Isamaeli ai Mesepa, ma latou foi mai, ma o mai ia loanana le atalii o Karea.

verses.en: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the Ammonites.
verses.sm: A ua sola Isamaeli le atalii o Netanaia ma tagata e toavalu ai Ioanana, ua alu atu foi ia i le fanauga a Amoni.

verses.en: Then took Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after that he had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, even mighty men of war, and the women, and the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought again from Gibeon:
verses.sm: Ona ave ai lea e Ioanana le atalii o Karea, ma alii uma sa ia te ia na ave “au, o e na totoe uma o le nuu, o e na ia faafoisia mai ai ia Isamaeli le atalii o Netanaia nai Mesepa, ina ua uma ona fasia e ia o Ketalia le atalii o Aikamo, o toa malolosi, ma fafine, ma tama iti, ma eunuka, o e na ia faafoisia mai mai Kipeona;

verses.en: And they departed, and dwelt in the habitation of Chimham, which is by Beth-lehem, to go to enter into Egypt,
verses.sm: ona latou o ai lea, ma latou nonofo i le fale o Kimeama, o loo lata ane i Peteleema, o le a o atu lava i Aikupito,

verses.en: Because of the Chaldeans: for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor in the land.
verses.sm: ona o Kaletaia; auá sa fefefe i latou ia te i latou, ona ua fasia e Isamaeli le atalii o Netanaia o Ketalia le atalii o Aikamo, o le na tofia e le tupu o Papelonia e pule ile nuu.
